facts.text: Six Senses London is set within The Whiteley, a reimagined West London landmark.
facts.excerpt: This is Six Senses London, a hotel set within The Whiteley, a West London landmark reimagined with purpose and care.

facts.text: The hotel offers courtyard calm, with Notting Hill just around the corner.
facts.excerpt: Find courtyard calm at the heart of the city, with Notting Hill color just around the corner

facts.text: Six Senses London has the first Six Senses Place, open to members and hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: The first Six Senses Place invites members and hotel guests into a world of connection and well-being.

facts.text: The spa offers treatments from cryotherapy to flotation.
facts.excerpt: Downstairs, a spa brings together pioneering treatments and timeless rituals, from cryotherapy to flotation.

facts.text: The address is 1 Redan Place, London W2.
Whiteley's Kitchen serves British cooking with seasonal, locally sourced ingredients transformed with fire and fermentation.
facts.excerpt: British cooking reimagined: seasonal, locally sourced ingredients transformed with fire, fermentation, and instinct.

facts.text: Whiteley's Cafe offers homemade bakes with small-batch coffee.
facts.excerpt: Homemade bakes and seasonal treats paired to perfection with small-batch coffee in a relaxed West London setting.

facts.text: Rooms feature soothing tones and leafy touches.
facts.excerpt: Soothing tones, leafy touches, and all the right details.

facts.text: The Fitness Center includes a light-filled studio and a team of professionals to guide training.
facts.excerpt: Fitness Center includes a light-filled studio and a team of professionals to guide your training.

facts.text: Past the reflective pool, the Wellness Studio offers space for mindful movement and restorative practices.
facts.excerpt: Past the reflective pool, the Wellness Studio offers a space for mindful movement and restorative practices.

facts.text: Across a bridge flanked by two natural tree sculptures, the Alchemy Bar turns British seasonal herbs into blends to create and take home.
facts.excerpt: Cross the bridge flanked by two towering natural tree sculptures and you reach the Alchemy Bar, where British seasonal herbs become blends to create and take home.

facts.text: The neighborhood offers Notting Hill color and Hyde Park calm.
facts.excerpt: Think Notting Hill color, Hyde Park calm, and the kind of surprises that make you look twice.
